brief:
Israel announced it will bar French left-wing presidential candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon from entry to the country, according to Middle East Eye. The ban follows Melenchon's pledge that French naval vessels would escort activist ships delivering humanitarian cargo to Gaza.

Melenchon has emerged as a prominent critic of Israeli policy toward Gaza, particularly regarding restrictions on aid flows into the territory.
dek: Israel says will ban French left-wing leader Melenchon from entry Israel said that it would ban French left-wing presidential contender Jean-Luc Melenchon from visiting after he vowed that French vessels would accompany activists hoping to force aid into Gaza…
title: Israel bans French leftist Melenchon over Gaza aid pledge
